342 / 343: Cortech Summit Side Table
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-342-343-summit-side-table
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/tables/summit-side-table/
Spec sheets: 342 / 343, Assembly, Bolt-down
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Summit Side Table – 342 / 343
Current H1: Cortech Summit Side Table - Molded Base with Laminate Top - Models 342 & 343
Subtitle: Low Side Table with a Molded Base and a Laminate Delta Top, in Small or Medium Sizes
Current subtitle: Cortech 342 Summit Low Table with Small Delta Top, Cortech 343 Summit Low Table with Mid Delta Top
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Summit Side Table is a low side table with a molded base and a laminate delta top, for lounges, dayrooms, waiting areas, and patient spaces in behavioral healthcare and other secure settings. It coordinates with Summit seating for a calm, residential look.
The one-piece molded base has no seams or joints to tamper with, and it attaches to the top with tamper-resistant screws. The table is designed to be weighted with sandbags in the base, and optional bolt-down plates are available.
Base: One-piece rotationally molded high impact polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Top: High-pressure laminate top with a Dura-Edge; it resists moisture and impact and cleans easily
Sizes: Small delta top (342) or medium delta top (343)
Dimensions: 22”W×22”D×18”H
Weight: 23 lbs (top 11 lbs, base 12 lbs)
Weighting: The base can be filled with sandbags; do not use loose sand. Optional bolt-down plates available
Flammability Standards: Laminate surfaces pass CAL 117; the base is flame retardant and passes California Technical Bulletin 133
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD Gold (laminate tops not included)
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Base Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty on the base; 5-year warranty on the laminate top, against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
342 – Small Delta Top: Summit Side Table
343 – Medium Delta Top: Summit Side Table
Installation and Options
Assembly: The base attaches to the top with tamper-resistant screws; hardware bit size is T40
Weighting: Add sandbags through the ballast door in the base; do not use loose sand. Ballast door bit size is T27
[H2] Applications
The Summit Side Table suits lounges and patient areas that want a small, stable table that is easy to clean.
Typical applications include:
Dayrooms, lounges, and waiting areas in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Dining and activity areas in residential treatment centers
Other secure settings that want a calm, residential look
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Summit Series
The Cortech Summit Series is a line of molded seating and tables with a calm, residential look, made for behavioral healthcare facilities and other secure settings. Most Summit seating comes in a standard molded finish or with a Veldura soft-touch exterior.
The Summit Series includes:
Chairs: Guest Chair (300 / 301), Accent Chair (310 / 311), and Lounge Chair (320 / 321)
Stools: Summit Stool (330 / 331)
Tables: Side Table (342 / 343), Mid-Range Table (353 / 354), and All Purpose Table (361 / 363 / 364)
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (50 characters): Cortech Summit Side Table - 342 / 343 at Anchortex
Meta description (160 characters): Shop the Cortech Summit Side Table. A low side table with a one-piece molded base and a laminate delta top in small or medium sizes for behavioral health rooms.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Summit Series" is a new section for the Summit chairs, stools, and tables. It is the same on each Summit page.
H1: I took out "Molded Base with Laminate Top" and "Models."
Variant names: your variants are 342S and 343S, "with ballast door." The Cortech spec sheet lists 342 and 343 only, with no S models. Can you check the model numbers with Cortech?
Weight: your variants are set to 255 lbs, which looks like a placeholder. The Cortech spec sheet says 23 lbs (top 11 lbs, base 12 lbs), so I used 23 lbs.
Dimensions: the Cortech spec sheet gives one size (22”×22”×18”H) and does not give a separate size for the medium top.
GREENGUARD Gold: the Cortech spec sheet says "Greenguard Gold Certified *Laminate Tops not included," which I read as the certification covering the base only. I wrote "(laminate tops not included)." Please check the wording.
Bolt-down plates: the Cortech spec sheet says optional bolt-down plates are available, and Cortech has bolt-down instructions for the side table, but there is no model number for the plates. The FAQ on the Cortech product page says the side table cannot be bolted down. I used the spec sheet. Can you check with Cortech?
Product images: the page has three images, including a Summit color chart. The Cortech product page has two photos of the side table with Summit chairs. Would you like me to add them?
